seo_title: Rotonda: Framer Template Design | The Brandle
summary: A Framer template for web studios, told as one long scroll story with a retro desktop you can use.

brief.label: Framer template, web studios
brief.heading: The idea
paras: Most studio sites list what they do. Rotonda shows it. The whole home page is one long story: a loader that cuts the site open, a square wheel that rolls itself round, and tickets that flip in.
It is a Framer template for web studios and freelancers who sell design and build work in packages.

answer.label: Launched 2026
answer.heading: What's inside
paras: Scroll far enough and the pricing page shrinks into a draggable window on a retro desktop, with photo, testimonial and FAQ windows to open. Then the lot pulls back into a CRT monitor. Nobody asked for this. That is rather the point.
Four page types, with case studies on Framer's CMS and three projects already written. The next-project link sets itself.
It is on the Framer Marketplace. Every line is written for a real studio, so you change the name, the work and the prices.
